sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: CTS wants the Court to hold that the federal statute only changes the start date for state filing deadlines.
Waldburger wants the Court to hold that the federal statute extends the total time available to file suit.

Waldburger argues the statute surgically modifies state tort actions by changing the commencement date for the time period.
